rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice when “elementary” means very simple or straightforward.

example.english: This maths problem is elementary; even children can do it.
example.traditional: 呢條數學題好簡單，小朋友都識做。
example.jyutping: nei1 tiu4 sou3 hok6 tai4 hou2 gaan2 daan1 siu2 pang4 jau5 dou1 sik1 zou6

rows.note: Choose this when “elementary” means fundamental or relating to the essential basis of something, rather than merely easy.

example.english: A good grasp of grammar is elementary to learning English.
example.traditional: 學好文法係學英文嘅基本。
example.jyutping: hok6 hou2 man4 faat3 hai6 hok6 jing1 man4 ge3 gei1 bun2
